description: IOC extractor — Extract indicators of compromise from any threat report, log, alert or email: URLs, domains, IPv4/IPv6 (private IPs skipped), emails, MD5/SHA1/SHA256/SHA512 hashes, CVE IDs, ETH/BTC addresses and suspicious file names. Refangs hxxp and [.] input, dedupes, and can return defanged copies. Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).

defang.description: true to also return defanged IOCs (optional)

text.description: Threat report or log text (required, up to 100k chars)
